pages.title: Sign in and set your password
pages.start: Open PK DTS
pages.action: Enter Username and Password; replace a temporary password when asked
pages.question: Are your sign-in details accepted?
pages.yes: Open Overview and the pages available to your account
pages.no: Read the message; correct your details or ask an Administrator for help, then retry
pages.result: You can use the pages and actions your account allows
notes: New and reset accounts must replace their temporary password before continuing.
Choose a different password with at least 9 characters. Enter it twice to confirm.
Your active roles combine their permissions. Sign out when finished on a shared device.

pages.title: Find a document and its current file
pages.start: You need a document or its approved file
pages.action: Open the document register; choose Table or Folder, search or filter, then open the record
pages.question: Can you view the record and use its file?
pages.yes: Read the details; use Download, Print or Softcopy File History when available
pages.no: Request Hardcopy or Softcopy access when available, or contact document control
pages.result: You can read the allowed details or use the current approved file
notes: Page access, document access and file actions are separate permissions. Pending proposal files are for authorized review.
External Documents use a separate category list and a Download action for the current file.
Softcopy shows permitted revision history. External revision records remain stored but have no separate File History action.

pages.title: Register or update a hardcopy
pages.start: Open Hardcopy Documents with the required permission
pages.action: Add or edit the record, storage place and retention dates; choose Save Document and confirm
pages.question: Are you allowed to save these details?
pages.yes: Save the record and show its holder, location, status and retention dates
pages.no: Correct the reported problem and retry; the record stays unchanged
pages.result: The record shows what the physical document is and where it is held
notes: Only an Administrator or the current holder with direct permission can edit. Only an Administrator can select a different holder.
New Hardcopy creation and update requests are unavailable; authorized users maintain records directly.
Choose matching Area, Specific, optional Asset and Location. Tracking retention requires both dates in order.

pages.title: Create or revise an electronic document directly
pages.start: Open Softcopy Documents or External Documents with direct permission
pages.action: Enter details and attach a file; confirm Approve Directly (Softcopy) or Save Directly (External)
pages.question: Do your permission, details and file pass the checks?
pages.yes: Create the record or make the replacement revision available immediately
pages.no: Correct the details or upload and retry; the approved record stays unchanged
pages.result: The current file is ready to use; permitted Softcopy history shows earlier revisions
notes: Softcopy Categories and External Categories are separate. Files must pass upload checks and be no larger than 15 MB.
A new registration and a revision both require a document file. Revision numbers and levels advance automatically.
Direct actions apply immediately. External revision records remain stored; a File History action is not provided.

pages.title: Request a new electronic document or revision
pages.start: You need approval to create or revise a Softcopy or External Document
pages.action: Choose the Softcopy or External request tab; select create or revise; enter details and upload the file
pages.question: Are the details, file and chosen document valid?
pages.yes: Save Draft, review the proposal, then Submit through My Requests
pages.no: Correct the reported problem and save again
pages.result: The request awaits approval. Its attachment becomes the current file only after final approval
notes: Default route: Requester's leader, then Plant Manager, then Document Control Officer. Published routes can be changed.
Revision requests select an active document in the correct register. The existing approved file remains current during review.
New Softcopy cancellation requests are unavailable. Retained historical requests may still appear.

pages.title: Save and submit a request
pages.start: Open your Draft or Returned request
pages.action: Check the proposal, document, attachments and remarks; save changes, then choose Submit
pages.question: Is the request ready, with available approvers?
pages.yes: Mark Submitted and send the first task to the assigned person or role
pages.no: Fix the reported details, or ask an Administrator to check the approval route; retry
pages.result: My Requests shows Submitted and the approval progress
notes: A returned request keeps its original approval route when resubmitted, even after an administrator publishes a newer route.
Cancel is available only for your own Draft. Delete is limited to your own Cancelled draft that was never submitted.
New Hardcopy create/update and Softcopy cancellation requests are unavailable; their past records remain readable.

pages.title: Approve an assigned request
pages.start: Open your assigned request in My Tasks
pages.action: Read the proposal, allowed files, earlier decisions and remarks; choose Approve and confirm
pages.question: Is this the final approval step?
pages.yes: Apply the approved change, access, assignment or disposal; prepare any transfer handoff
pages.no: Send the request to the next approver for review
pages.result: PK DTS saves the decision and updates progress until final approval
notes: Only the currently assigned user or an active member of the assigned role can decide that step.
The approved operation takes effect at final approval. An approved transfer still requires Dispatch and Accept.
If a decision cannot be saved or applied, read the error and refresh before retrying.

pages.title: Return or reject a request
pages.start: You find a problem while reviewing an assigned request
pages.action: Check the issue; choose Return or Reject, add remarks if useful, then confirm
pages.question: Return the request for another review?
pages.yes: Send it to the previous approver; at the first step, send it back to the requester
pages.no: Reject and close the request. Keep its history without applying the proposed change
pages.result: Review resumes where needed. Only a first-step Return lets the requester edit and resubmit
notes: A return from a later step leaves the request Submitted and gives the task back to the previous approver.
After that approver approves again, the returned step must review again before approval can advance.
A first-step return marks the request Returned. The requester corrects it and resubmits using the original route.

pages.title: Request a hardcopy transfer
pages.start: You need to move an active hardcopy
pages.action: Select the document, receiving user, destination storage and remarks; save and submit the transfer request
pages.question: Have all required approvers approved?
pages.yes: Prepare the handoff and mark it For Transfer
pages.no: Follow the Return or Reject outcome. Dispatch becomes available after final approval
pages.result: The original requester can dispatch the approved document
notes: Default route: Plant Manager, then Document Control Officer, then Requester confirmation.
The source and destination must be valid and the receiving account active; conflicting pending requests or transfers can block it.
Approval alone does not change the current holder or complete physical receipt.

pages.title: Dispatch and receive a hardcopy
pages.start: The approved transfer shows For Transfer
pages.action: The requester confirms Dispatch. After the document arrives, the named receiver opens the handoff task
pages.question: Has the named receiver confirmed Accept?
pages.yes: Complete the transfer; update the holder and destination location
pages.no: Leave In Transit until the receiver confirms physical receipt
pages.result: The record shows the new holder, location and completed handoff history
notes: Only the requester dispatches. Only the named receiving user accepts that transfer.
Dispatch marks In Transit. Custody and location change after acceptance.
Direct reassignment is a separate immediate action and is blocked while a transfer is active.

pages.title: Request access or assignment for yourself
pages.start: Requester chooses Document Access or Document Assignment
pages.action: Select an active Softcopy or Hardcopy; enter the reason and, for access, a future expiry; save and submit
pages.question: Have all required approvers approved?
pages.yes: Grant access until expiry, add you as a Softcopy assignee, or make you the Hardcopy holder
pages.no: Follow the Return or Reject outcome; access and assignment stay unchanged
pages.result: You receive the approved access or assignment
notes: Access default: Plant Manager, Document Control Officer, Requester confirmation. Assignment ends with Requester's leader instead.
These requests are for the requester; they do not select another recipient. External Documents are not supported here.
Access expires at the end of the chosen day. Assignment is separate from an access grant; file permissions still apply.

pages.title: Dispose of a document directly
pages.start: Select an active document you are allowed to dispose of directly
pages.action: Choose Dispose; select Shred, Scratch or Other; describe Other when used; confirm disposal
pages.question: Do you have both permissions and a valid reason?
pages.yes: Mark Disposed; save the reason, person, date and earlier record details
pages.no: Correct the reason, or ask an Administrator to review your permissions; retry
pages.result: The document register shows Disposed and its disposal history
notes: Direct disposal supports Hardcopy, Softcopy and External Documents; both register direct and disposal direct permission are required.
Softcopy disposal retires its files. External disposal keeps stored files and revision records but blocks normal download.
Direct Hardcopy disposal keeps its recorded location. Approval-based Hardcopy disposal clears the location and personal grants.

pages.title: Request hardcopy or external disposal
pages.start: You need approval to dispose of an active document
pages.action: Choose Disposal Request; select Hardcopy or External, the document and disposal reason; save and submit
pages.question: Have all required approvers approved disposal?
pages.yes: Dispose the selected document and preserve its approval and disposal history
pages.no: Follow the Return or Reject outcome; the document is not disposed of
pages.result: The completed request shows the disposed document and approved reason
notes: Example route: Plant Manager, Document Control Officer, then Requester confirmation. Check the published route. Softcopy disposal requests are unavailable.
Choose Shred, Scratch or Other. Other needs a description of up to 250 characters.
Approved Hardcopy disposal clears Location and personal access grants. External disposal keeps files and revision records.

pages.title: Assign documents directly
pages.start: Authorized controller opens Document Assignments
pages.action: Choose a document, Hardcopy location or Softcopy category branch; select the receiving user and confirm
pages.question: Are the active documents and user eligible?
pages.yes: Add the Softcopy assignee or change the Hardcopy holder immediately
pages.no: Resolve active transfers, choose valid records or reduce the selection; retry
pages.result: The assignment list and document details show the updated assignee or holder
notes: Softcopy category assignment includes its subcategories. Location assignment includes all active Hardcopies stored there.
Bulk assignment supports up to 2,000 active documents. An active Hardcopy transfer blocks reassignment.
Direct assignment needs no approval, Dispatch or Accept. It changes records without moving documents or granting personal access.

pages.title: Set up storage places and categories
pages.start: Authorized maintainer opens Setup Places
pages.action: Choose the place or category tab; add or edit its name, folder and parent details; confirm Save
pages.question: Are the details, parent choices and permission valid?
pages.yes: Save the entry for use in the matching document register
pages.no: Correct the name or parent choices shown in the message and retry
pages.result: The updated choices appear in document forms and Folder view
notes: Areas, Specifics, optional Assets and Locations describe Hardcopy storage. Maintain their valid parent relationships.
Softcopy Categories and External Categories are separate trees. Categories can contain subcategories.
Deactivate an entry to stop new selection while retaining historical links; existing relationships can restrict changes.

pages.title: Create or update a user account
pages.start: Authorized account administrator opens User Management
pages.action: Enter user details, Primary role, Assigned roles and leader; save, reset the password or choose Deactivate
pages.question: Are the role, leader and account changes allowed?
pages.yes: Save the account; give any temporary password securely to the intended user
pages.no: Correct the role or leader choices, or the protected account change; retry
pages.result: The account has the chosen roles and leader. New or reset users change password at next sign-in
notes: Primary and assigned active roles combine permissions. The leader receives steps configured as Requester's leader.
Users cannot deactivate themselves or change their own roles. The final active Administrator cannot be removed.
Account and role changes can require a fresh sign-in. Assigned Documents requires both user-view and direct-assignment permission.

pages.title: Set roles and permissions
pages.start: Authorized role administrator opens Roles & Permissions
pages.action: Add or edit a role name and allowed actions; save, deactivate or remove the selected role
pages.question: Is the change allowed, with no blocking links?
pages.yes: Save the allowed actions, or deactivate or remove the unused role
pages.no: Check linked users, approval steps and unfinished requests; correct the issue and retry
pages.result: Users can open the pages and use the actions allowed by their active roles
notes: Supplied roles: Administrator, Document Control Officer, Plant Manager, Internal Auditor and Staff. Custom roles can be added.
Administrator privileges are fixed. Other roles can be configured; an administrator cannot delegate actions they lack.
A role cannot be deactivated or removed while assigned to users, used by current workflows or needed by unfinished requests.

pages.title: Publish an approval route
pages.start: Authorized workflow administrator opens Workflow Builder
pages.action: Create Next Draft; add or edit approvers; move or remove steps; choose Validate & Publish
pages.question: Does the route have 1-30 valid steps in order?
pages.yes: Publish the route for future submissions of this request type
pages.no: Add missing steps or replace unavailable users and roles, then validate again
pages.result: Future submissions use the new route. Previously submitted requests keep their original route
notes: Approvers can be a specific user, any active member of a role, the Requester's leader or the Requester account.
Published versions are read-only. Use Create Next Draft, or Start First Draft when no version exists.
Only one draft per workflow is available. The request types are predefined; configuring a route does not enable retired request types.

pages.title: Follow task and retention reminders
pages.start: You see a task notice, unread bell entry or retention reminder
pages.action: Open the notice; inspect the linked request, handoff or Hardcopy record
pages.question: Is there an action you need and are allowed to take?
pages.yes: Complete the assigned task, or arrange the appropriate hardcopy review or disposal
pages.no: Close the notice. Reading or dismissing it does not change the document
pages.result: The notice leads you to the record or task that needs attention
notes: Selecting an unread bell entry acknowledges that entry. Opening the panel does not mark every entry read.
Retention reminders concern visible active Hardcopies with retention enabled and an end date today or earlier, using Manila dates.
Retention reminders are shown once per document and end date in the browser session; dismissing one leaves the record unchanged.

pages.title: Trace an action in the audit trail
pages.start: An authorized audit reviewer needs to trace a recorded action
pages.action: Open Internal Audit Trail; search or filter by date and result; review who acted and what happened
pages.question: Did you find the action you need?
pages.yes: Check the time, person, result and details against the document or request history
pages.no: Change the search or dates; ask the Administrator to investigate missing records
pages.result: The reviewer understands the recorded action and any follow-up needed
notes: The supplied Administrator, Document Control Officer and Internal Auditor roles can view the audit trail; custom grants may differ.
Use success or failed outcomes to narrow the list. Audit review does not change a document or reverse an approval.
Document details and request approval history provide related context for the recorded action.

pages.title: Create and manage backups
pages.start: Authorized backup operator opens Backup & Restore
pages.action: Choose Backup now, Import backup, Download or Clean up; confirm the selected operation
pages.question: Are backup setup and the selected file ready?
pages.yes: Create or import a checked, protected backup, download it, or remove eligible older archives
pages.no: Read the setup or backup error and correct it before retrying
pages.result: The backup list and completion message show what happened
notes: Viewing backups and managing or downloading them require different permissions. Check the success message and resulting archive.
The displayed daily target is 5:00 PM Asia/Manila. Automatic backup runs require separate administrator setup and verification.
Clean up removes expired backup and log archives under the configured retention rules. Import verifies the supplied backup ZIP.

pages.title: Restore records and private files
pages.start: Authorized backup operator chooses Restore system data
pages.action: Select Backup to restore; enter Your password; type RESTORE; confirm Restore selected backup
pages.question: Do the password, confirmation and backup checks pass?
pages.yes: Save a recovery backup, restore the chosen records and private files, then sign out the operator
pages.no: Read the error; correct the password, confirmation or backup problem before retrying
pages.result: Sign in again and check the restored records, users and files
notes: Restore replaces live records and private files. Normal use is temporarily blocked during the maintenance operation.
A recovery backup is created before replacement. Keep the selected backup and recovery archive available for follow-up checks.
Application code recovery is an offline maintenance task; it is not performed by the Restore system data button.
